title: City of Westbrook — IFB, Water Main Replacement (State Revolving Fund)
labelled_by: Claude (AI), written together with the synthetic document; independent human review pending
notes: Authored for this evaluation to mirror common solicitation structures; not a real procurement.

requirements.quote: Sealed bids are due at 11:00 a.m. on July 15, 2026
all iron and steel products used in the project must be produced in the United States
Bidders shall submit the AIS Certification with the bid
must pay wages not less than the Davis-Bacon prevailing wage rates
shall make good faith efforts to meet the DBE fair share objectives of 4% MBE and 6% WBE
shall submit EPA Forms 6100-3 and 6100-4 with the bid
Bidders must not be suspended or debarred from federal programs
shall submit the Certification Regarding Debarment (Attachment E)
Bidders shall submit unit prices for every line item on the Bid Schedule
A bid bond of five percent (5%) of the total base bid is required
must be prequalified with the Westbrook Public Works Department in the Underground Utilities category prior to bid opening
at least five (5) years of experience installing ductile iron water mains of 8-inch diameter or larger
All work shall be completed within 180 calendar days of the Notice to Proceed
A Traffic Control Plan prepared by a certified traffic control supervisor shall be submitted to the City Engineer

traps.quote: In case of a discrepancy between a unit price and the extended total, the unit price will govern
traps.why: Owner's rule for reading bids, not a bidder obligation

traps.quote: The City will provide water for testing and flushing at no charge
traps.why: Obligation or right of the owner, not the bidder
